The dark wood of the bed frame and the light color of his shirt create a high-contrast visual. The composition remains a static medium shot.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a comedy sketch satirizing typical behaviors in Taiwan during a typhoon day. It contrasts the absurdity of trying to book entertainment like KTV when everything is closed or full with the chaotic and excessive nature of panic-buying groceries and supplies at home.
